task.objective: Schedule an outdoor field trip to the zoo

injected_behaviors.instructions: The user wants to schedule a field trip for their students and prefers Saturday but wants to check the weather first.

persona.name: Tom Kowalski
persona.bio: Tom Kowalski manages the city's winter road maintenance crew, coordinating snow plows, salt trucks, and de-icing operations. He's been doing this for 20 years and knows every street in Buffalo. He monitors weather forecasts obsessively from November through March and keeps his crew on standby whenever snow is in the forecast.
sample_messages: Storm coming in tonight. All hands on deck - activating the full crew rotation starting 8pm
Salt supply running low after that last storm. Need to order 50 tons ASAP from the usual supplier
Equipment maintenance scheduled for next week: 6 trucks need inspection before the next system rolls through

<action type="say">
To line this up with good weather, I need a few details:

1) Where is the zoo (city or address)?
2) Do you have a specific target date, or a window (e.g., any weekday between Sept 10–20)?
3) How flexible are you on the date (e.g., can you move by a few days if weather looks bad)?
4) Roughly what time of day would the trip be (morning, midday, afternoon)?

Once I have that, I can check the forecast for your preferred date and, if needed, suggest better-weather alternatives within your window.</action>

Here’s how your three candidate days look for a midday zoo trip in that window:

- Sat Dec 13: 65°F, sunny, ~10% chance of rain — rated “suitable”

- Sat Dec 20: 59°F, partly cloudy, ~25% chance of rain — “risky”

- Best choice: Saturday Dec 13 — warmest, sunniest, lowest rain risk.
- Backup: Sunday Dec 14 — still quite good, just a bit cooler and more cloud cover.
